data.plain_english: Interest rates on US government borrowing have climbed to their highest level in many years. The council thinks this is likely to weigh on Hong Kong shares, because Hong Kong's currency is tied to the US dollar and its borrowing costs tend to follow America's. Property companies in both Hong Kong and the US look most vulnerable, since they rely heavily on borrowing. For US technology, banks and energy, the council has no clear view. The biggest disagreement is over Hong Kong banks: some members think the fall already reflects the bad news, others do not. This is research to help you think, not advice to buy or sell anything.
